title: Wall of Stone
lyrics:
The Time Had Come… My Heart Was Numb.
One Deep Sigh… The Long Good-Bye.
We Stood Tall… Children And All.
Heads Bowed In Awe… For God's Last Call.

Soldiers In Line… It's Almost Time.
Pride In Chest… At Parade Rest.
Now We Stand… And Hear The Command.
Two In Stride… Not Their First Time.

A Flag They Hold… Corner To Corner.
13 Folds… In Your Honor.
The Soldier Finds His Next In Line.
Tears Now Climb… Can't Stop Time.

5 Rifles High. Into the Sky.
3 Shots Fired. 15 Retired.
Shells to the Ground. Makes a Sound.
I Now hold… Deep Deep Down.

**Chorus** 
*15 Shells and a Wall Of Stone. Locked inside but Not Alone.
Shells to the Ground. Now A Sound. That I Hold Dear… Deep Deep Down.*

**Bridge**
Last In the Row… A Bugle Blows.
Taps an Echo… Tears Now Flow.
All is Silent… We Stand Alone.
Not your Home… This Tall Wall of Stone.

It's Later Now… Hard to Believe.
Few Know How… These Shells Remind Me.
I am your Son… and Proud To Be.
I am your Son… Yeah This is Me.
bio:
Respect - Love of Parents
A Final Celebration

title: Chains Of St. James
lyrics:
In 1831… Under A Hot Sun.
Sugar And Slaves… Were Bound As One.
It Was Always Known… Not To Be Undone.
Owned By A Throne… And Ruled By A Gun.
But In Old St James… On A Cold Christmas Day.
This Would Change… In Every Way.

**Chorus** 
*To the Souls… Who Fought & Prayed.*
*You Broke These Old Chains… On that Day.*

 Led By A Cross… The Slaves Without A Cost.
Armed With Rage… They Rose Up Day.
They Set Fires Ablaze… For Each To Say.
Be On Your Way… Be Free This Day.
For 11 Days… They All Defied.
Then they Paid… With 500 Lives.

**Chorus** 
*To the Souls… Who Fought & Prayed.*
*You Broke These Old Chains… On that Day.*

**Bridge**
And Their Leader… A Baptist Preacher.
On That Day… Was Hung… in Montego Bay.

**Chorus** 
 *To the Souls… Who Fought & Prayed.*
*You Broke These Old Chains… On that Day.*

We Know Today… This Was Not In Silent Pain.
You Did Not Die… Did Not Die in Vain.
By 1834… A New Law Was Made.
There will be no more… Chains in St James.
No more… No More Chains in St James.

title: The Preacher Ran
subTitle: Every Grave is a Story
lyrics:
I Tried To Go… It Was Getting Late.
A Grave Alone… Slowed My Pace.
On This Stone… A Sinner's Fate.
Words Now Moaned… The Sound Of Hate.

**Chorus**
*Most Fear, the Guns of War.*
*Some Fear, the Swing of a Sword.*
*Liars Fear, Their Own Front Door.*
*This One Fears, That and More.*

The Fight Began… A Fight To Win.
There Was No Plan… A Fight For Kin.
This Preacher Ran… He Knew He Sinned.
When Father Dan… Grabbed His Gin.

Riley Kate… Was Now Aglow.
Told to Wait… She Didn't Know.
Now She's Late… And Began To Show.
This Preacher Mate… Had to Go.

**Chorus**
*Most Fear, the Guns of War.*
*Some Fear, the Swing of a Sword.*
*Liars Fear, Their Own Front Door.*
*This One Fears, That and More.*

No One Helped… The Preacher Hide.
Then He Yelped… He Knew He Lied.
Dan Had Felt… A Father's Pride.
And With His Belt… Dan Did Tie.

He Made A Noose… To Do the Deed.
His Vengeance Loose… The Preacher's Seed.
There Was No Truce… Just Rage & Speed.
No Excuse… Now Headstone Reads.

**Chorus**
*Most Fear, the Guns of War.*
*Some Fear, the Swing of a Sword.*
*Liars Fear, Their Own Front Door.*
*This One Fears, That and More.*

And So It Goes… No One Wins.
Now We Know… How Hell Begins.
But Deep Below… Revenge of Kin.
He Had to Go… The Preacher Sinned.

title: Respect
subTitle: Stop & Say Thank You
lyrics:
Old Wood Floors… And 3 High Tables.
Bar Maid Pours… From Whiskey Labels.
Men Of War… Now Rusty Angels.
A Time Before… Fallen Halos.

**Chorus**
*These Men Lead… With Reputation…*
*Their Pride Needs… No Explanation.*
*They Did For Me… Their Generation…*
*Our Flag is Free… One God One Nation.*

I Don't Know How… To Show Respect.
I Know Somehow… I Might Regret.
I Stare & Now… They Suspect.
My Head Just Bowed… A Bit Direct.

**Chorus**
*These Men Lead… With Reputation…*
*Their Pride Needs… No Explanation.*
*They Did For Me… Their Generation…*
*Our Flag is Free… One God One Nation.*

The Old One Looked… At Me with Pause.
I Just Stood… Without A Cause.
My Pride Was True… But Still Felt Flawed.
He Just Knew… Respect & Awe.

**Chorus**
*These Men Lead… With Reputation…*
*Their Pride Needs… No Explanation.*
*They Did For Me… Their Generation…*
*Our Flag is Free… One God One Nation.*

We Never Met… But I Now See.
It's With Regret… I Let It Be.
I Should Have Said… More Carefully.
My Respect… Is My Decree.

My Thanks to You… I Am Me.
Because of You… We Are Free.
Respect is Due… To You I See.
My Thanks To You… My Son Will Be.

**Chorus**
*These Men Lead… With Reputation…*
*Their Pride Needs… No Explanation.*
*They Did For Me… Their Generation…*
*Our Flag is Free… One God One Nation.*

title: Songs and Stitches
subTitle: Fun and Simple
lyrics:
Dug Up & Stole… From Dusty Old Licks.
Songs Are Just Old… Pieces & Bits.
The Good Ones Find… A Rhythm Or Trick.
But Most Songs Fold… And Die In A Fit.

Some Songs Steal… Or Bend A Rhyme.
To Help You Feel… That's Not A Crime.
But Few Are One… One Of A Kind.
Most Are New… Like Frankenstein.

**Chorus**
*Steal a Lyric, Bend a Rhyme.*
*Songs are Just Like… Frankenstein.*
*With Borrowed Notes That Fall & Climb.*
*With Stitches & Bolts, To Help Align.*

Most Old Rhymes… From Past Times.
Are Stole In Body… And Then In Mind.
All From Hearses… Like Frankenstein.
Become Old Verses… With Really Bad Wine.

**Chorus**
*Steal a Lyric, Bend a Rhyme.*
*Songs are Just Like… Frankenstein.*
*With Borrowed Notes That Fall & Climb.*
*With Stitches & Bolts, To Help Align.*

*Steal a Lyric… Bend a Rhyme… Songs are Like… Frankenstein.*

We Need More Wine…

title: Angry Penguins
lyrics:
I Used to Be Fast… A Bounce in my Step.
Thought it Would Last… I was the Best. 
To Run or Dash… I Was Impressed. 
When People I Passed… I'd Puff up my Chest.  

This Story Starts… When I'm not Sure. 
When Some of My Parts… Just Took A Detour. 
They Were Not Smart… Or Even Ensured. 
Like A Wobbly Cart… Grade A Manure. 

We Wobble to the left. We Wobble to the Right. Step by Step. Is a brand-new Fight. Knees don't work. Back ain't right. An Angry Wreck. Like A Penguin Fight.  

My Left Foot Moans… That's a new One. 
My Right Knee Groans… I Know that One. 
A Mind of its Own… My Hip Thinks it's Done. 
An Ache in My Bones… This just Aint Fun. 

We Wobble to the left. We Wobble to the Right. Step by Step. Is a brand-new Fight. Knees don't work. Back ain't right. An Angry Wreck. Like A Penguin Fight.  

[bridge]
I'd Rather Have… A Beer Instead. 
I just Look Mad… I'm Not Dead. 
I know this Looks Sad… It's All In My Head. 
Yeah but This is Bad… Just Go to Bed. 

We Wobble to the left. We Wobble to the Right. Step by Step. Is a brand-new Fight. Knees don't work. Back ain't right. An Angry Wreck. Like A Penguin Fight.   

I Feel A Crash… My Toe Hurts.
My Arm has a Rash… My Butt is Worse
I Need To Scratch… I'm Gonna Burst. 
Gone in a Flash… Silver Alert.

title: Devil's Quake
lyrics:
Far Away… With the Rising Sun.
The Soul of Man… Had No Where to Run.
A Town Still Small… Young in Age. 
Born Of Hope… Silk & Sage. 

The Story's Goes… The Seasons Late.  
The Sea Was Cold… Bones would Ache. 
God Said No… To Man's Fate. 
Then Shook… the Devil Awake. 

Why God… Why Me… Could You not… Just Let Me Be?

Out to Sea… the Ground Shook. 
All Came Down… Nothing Stood. 
Shock & Awe… from Shore to Shore. 
Please God Stop… But There was More. 

Hard they Tried… Sons & Daughters. 
They Could Not Hide… From the Waters. 
Drowned By Sea… The Story Tells. 
Drowned by Three… Waves From Hell.

Why God… Why Me… Could You not… Just Let Me Be?

Many Cried… There Can't Be More. 
Then From Hills… The Fires Roared.
All the Homes… Like Not Before.
A Burning Hell… Burned Some More.

Why God… Why Me… Could You not… Just Let Me Be?

Then with Time… It was Quiet. 
The Devil's Crime… was Now Silent. 
What was Born… From Silk & Sage. 
Now Just Died… in Angry Rage. 

And Gods Reply… The Why To Me.  
Was Quick & Clear… You are Free.
But I Will Not. Just Let You Be. 
Your Time is Now… To Bend the Knee.

title: Man with the Beard
lyrics:
5 feet Strong… And A puff of Smoke. 
Old Jeans On… Far from Woke.
Days Are Long… He's Almost Broke.
Not Yet Gone… Still with Hope. 

The Man Defied… But Time Made Clear. 
Hard was the Ride… And Long Was his Beard.
A Limp in his Stride… But He Could Still Hear. 
Driven by Pride… and 16 Gears. 

38 Tons & 18 Tires. Coming in Hot with Wheels on Fire. 
Right On Time, Under the Wire. 38 Tons & 18 Tires.

A Love for the Ride… He was made Strong. 
Still alive… But far from Dawn. 
Once He Cried… A Pain He Pawned. 
He Tried to Hide… But then It Was Gone. 

38 Tons & 18 Tires. Coming in Hot with Wheels on Fire. 
Right On Time, Under the Wire. 38 Tons & 18 Tires.

bridge
Home To Rest… In time to Pray. 
He Did it Best… All His Way. 
The Wild West… Some did Say. 
But God He Blessed… Most of the Days. 

38 Tons & 18 Tires. Coming in Hot with Wheels on Fire. 
Right On Time, Under the Wire. 38 Tons & 18 Tires.

When he Appeared… At Heaven's Gate.
The Man With the Beard… Knew His Fate.   
He Held High His Beer… There was no Wait. 
St. Peter now Steered… He Wasn't Late.

title: Hello Finnigan
lyrics:
On Hills Steep… Far from Home.
Where The Grass is Deep… And The Mind Roams.
At the Peak… Old White Stones.
Very Asleep… Dead & Alone.

Headstones Tell… Of Love Or Sin.
Heaven & Hell… and Past Kin.
This Stone Head… Made Me Grin.
All It Said… Was Finnigan.

That's All… No Goodbye.
No Recall… Of When You Died.
How Did You Fall… Or if you Lied.
A Deadly Brawl… I had to know Why.

And So My Mind… Quickly Framed.
A Fable in Kind… From Only One Name.
A Story in Time… Without Shame.
A Kin of Mine… Our Names The Same.

Hello Finnigan. Who Lived Back When. You Traveled The World. And Back Again.
Where Were You Going? Where Have You Been? It's Good To See You My Old Friend.

The Story Cries… Your Lost at Sea.
How and Why… At 23.
The Crew Defied… A Mutiny.
Then You Died… Hard to Believe.

The Soul of A Gypsy… The Heart of A King.
A Life At Sea… On Angels Wing.
Your Love Was She… A Sea to Sing.
Your Life Was Free… Then 5 Bells Ring.

But if That Is So… This Can't Be.
A Headstone… That's NOT at Sea.
Only I Know… A Lie You See.
As Buried Below… Is Just Your Ring.

Hello Finnegan. Who Lived Back When. You Traveled The World. And Back Again.
Where Were You Going? Where Have You Been? It's Good To See You My Old Friend.

title: First Shot Fired
lyrics:
On This Hill… Covered With Sheep.
Blood Was Spilled… Now Headstones Peak.
My Mind Stilled… Hard To Speak.
Who was Killed… The Truth I Seek.

They All Lay… Cold in the Sun.
A War in One Day… No Where To Run.
Kin They Say… Brothers & Sons.
No One Prayed… All 20 When Done.

War Begins… With Someone To Blame.
War Ends… Mostly the Same.
Truth Bends… To Cover The Shame.
Those In the End… Feel The Pain.

First to Fire… Was Finnigan
Defending a Liar… His Brother Again.
His Last Desired… A Pain & A Sin.
A Nun in the Choir… Then the War Begins.

On That Day… Finnigan Died.
In Every Way… No One Cried.
Dead they Say… But He Was Alive.
He Ran Away… His Grave a Lie.

War Begins… With Someone To Blame.
War Ends… Mostly the Same.
Truth Bends… To Cover The Shame.
Those In the End… Feel The Pain.

Off To Sea… On Sails & Wings.
He Was Free… Like A Gypsy King.
But in The Ground?… As Few Would Sing.
Finnigan Smiled… He Forgot His Ring.
